newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Sa Sa Int'l says to offer 328 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's Sa Sa Int'l says to offer 328 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Cosmetics products wholesaler and retailer Sa Sa International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it is offering 328 million new shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at a price from HK$2.00 to HK$2.38 each.
The company said 65.6 million shares, or 20 percent of the new issue, would be offered to the public in Hong Kong, while the balance of 262.40 million shares would be placed internationally.

The Hong Kong public offer portion would be increased to 35 percent if the subscription level reached 10 times. The company also granted the underwriters an overallotment option to require it to issue up to 49.20 million additional shares.
The IPO will run from June 3 to 6 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on June 13.
The final price will be fixed on June 6.
Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) Ltd is the global coordinator, sponsor and lead manager of the issue.
Sa Sa said it expected to raise net proceeds of about HK$745 million from the issue.

HK$60.00 million would be used to expand its retail network in Hong Kong, HK$371.00 million to expand its retail network in Japan, Macau, Malaysia, Singapore and Taiwan, and HK$110 million would be used to buy prime retail outlets in Hong Kong.

Another HK$50 million would be used for the acquisition of newly developed products from cosmetic makers and the promotion of its brand name products, HK$20 million for the purchase of of established brandnames, HK$27 million to repay debt and the balance for working capital, it said.

Sa Sa International is engaged in the retail and wholesale of a wide range of cosmetic products including skin-care, make-up, fragrances and hair care products. It operates a chain of 11 retail outlets in Hong Kong and one in Taipei in Taiwan.
